answer: Sybil resistance through bonded stake: each agent must lock a refundable bond in a scarce on-chain asset before it can transact, with tiers labeled by size, say Jade for small stakes and Quartz for larger ones. Spinning up 1,000 fake agents then costs 1,000 separate bonds, not one cheap key. Any cheating is slashed, and that loss ripples across sybils sharing collateral, so punishing one identity deters the whole cluster.
